properties.name: spring.gson.date-format
properties.description: Format to use when serializing Date objects.

properties.name: spring.gson.disable-html-escaping
properties.description: Whether to disable the escaping of HTML characters such as '<', '>', etc.

properties.name: spring.gson.disable-inner-class-serialization
properties.description: Whether to exclude inner classes during serialization.

properties.name: spring.gson.enable-complex-map-key-serialization
properties.description: Whether to enable serialization of complex map keys (i.e. non-primitives).

properties.name: spring.gson.exclude-fields-without-expose-annotation
properties.description: Whether to exclude all fields from consideration for serialization or deserialization that do not have the "Expose" annotation.

properties.name: spring.gson.field-naming-policy
properties.description: Naming policy that should be applied to an object's field during serialization and deserialization.

properties.name: spring.gson.generate-non-executable-json
properties.description: Whether to generate non-executable JSON by prefixing the output with some special text.

properties.name: spring.gson.long-serialization-policy
properties.description: Serialization policy for Long and long types.

properties.name: spring.gson.pretty-printing
properties.description: Whether to output serialized JSON that fits in a page for pretty printing.

properties.name: spring.gson.strictness
properties.description: Sets how strictly the RFC 8259 specification will be enforced when reading and writing JSON.
